purpose: NEW isolated always-on workflow that ticks the Windows LOCAL_DEV autonomous dispatcher every 2 minutes over Tailscale-private transport, normalizes the bounded tick result, and deduplicates Telegram alerts by the active actionable state in the existing n8n Data Table control_plane_state (key wf90:active_alert_signature). A new or changed human-gate / executor-STOP / service-error state notifies once; an unchanged state is suppressed; a non-actionable result clears the episode. No WF40 node graph change. No production authorization. No D-0025 activation. Notification-only Telegram usage; credentials are cloned in memory at LIVE APPLY time and never persisted in this artifact. ISSUE #87: eligible HUMAN_GATE notifications may carry canonical bounded choices (operator_action_choices from the dispatcher) and render as an interactive Telegram handoff; informational gates unchanged.
authority_note: This workflow JSON is GPT-Web-authored per operator dispatch V4_LOCAL_DEV_N8N_ALWAYS_ON_LIVE_FAST_TRACK_V1 (GPT_WEB authoring override of GPT_WEB_N8N_AUTHORING_REQUIRED).
